I'll create a standard work schedule record for Jordan Lee and merge it into the employment record.

```python
import pandas as pd

# --- Reconstruct the employment record (EMP-1001) ---
employment_record = pd.DataFrame([{
    "employee_id":     "EMP-1001",
    "employee_name":   "Jordan Lee",
    "position":        "Data Analyst",
    "department":      "Analytics",
    "manager":         "Alex Rivera",
    "start_date":      pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "employment_type": "Full-time",
    "jurisdiction":    "California",
    "effective_date":  pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "end_date":        pd.NaT,
    "status":          "Active",
    "record_created":  pd.Timestamp("2026-10-12"),
}])

# --- Work schedule definition (Pacific Time) ---
schedule = {
    "work_days":       "Monday-Friday",
    "work_day_list":   ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"],
    "shift_start":     "09:00",
    "shift_end":       "17:00",
    "hours_per_day":   8.0,
    "hours_per_week":  40.0,
    "time_zone":       "America/Los_Angeles",   # Pacific Time
    "tz_label":        "PT",
    "schedule_effective_date": pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "schedule_end_date":       pd.NaT,          # open-ended
}

# Merge schedule fields into the employment record
for key in ["work_days", "shift_start", "shift_end", "hours_per_day",
            "hours_per_week", "time_zone", "tz_label"]:
    employment_record[key] = schedule[key]

employment_record["schedule_effective_date"] = pd.to_datetime(schedule["schedule_effective_date"])
employment_record["schedule_end_date"]       = pd.to_datetime(schedule["schedule_end_date"])

# --- Validate alignment: schedule start must match employment effective date ---
sched_ok = employment_record.loc[0, "schedule_effective_date"] == employment_record.loc[0, "effective_date"]

print("=== Employment Record with Work Schedule ===")
with pd.option_context("display.max_columns", None, "display.width", 200):
    print(employment_record.T.to_string())

print("\n--- Schedule Validation ---")
print(f"Work Days:            Mon-Fri")
print(f"Shift:                09:00 - 17:00 PT")
print(f"Hours / Week:         {schedule['hours_per_week']}")
print(f"Time Zone:            {schedule['time_zone']} ({schedule['tz_label']})")
print(f"Schedule Effective:   {employment_record.loc[0,'schedule_effective_date'].date()}")
print(f"Aligns w/ Employment Effective Date: {sched_ok}")
```
